execution_diagnosis.description: Uncapped raw proposals first pass threshold and stay filters, then coordinator cooldown. Cooldown-rejected proposals are distinct from all PP decisions. Complete accepted traces verify actual switch spacing.

interpretation: B195 replaces the original A B100 model under the same top1 selection, S veto and450-second spacing. Complete colliding runs remain in efficiency means; invalid runs disable means. Extra labels increase the training budget; these inspected evaluation seeds provide development evidence.

decision.criterion: Sign of the frozen equal-seed mean_queue difference; descriptive service metrics do not replace it.

limitations: B195 uses95 additional label groups and is not a same-budget algorithm improvement over A.
The additional labels add time coverage in the same three training seeds rather than new seed diversity.
The three closed-loop seeds have been repeatedly inspected and remain development evidence.

next_step.selection_rule: Add100000 and200000 to each original evaluation seed, preserving original seed order.
